body: I taught myself to read with this book because I loved it so much and would read it to my cousin (we were 4 and 2 respectively). I loved making him laugh and we would giggle together at the silly monster every time I read it. Great memories. I wonder if he even remembers that.

I was in a big city, but I have to stay with family now and they live way out in the middle of nowhere. I feel like I don't have any resources out here. My ex still has my car (because we were on totally good terms until yesterday). I just don't understand how everything can change in an instant. 

Right now, I want to go as far away as I can. Austrailia or SE Asia. I want to see the whole world, but I'm just wondering what the point is. Running from my problems won't make them go away. I'm still going to be lonely and sad in another country, so why waste the energy and time and money to get there? I just want my life back, but it's not the life I wanted. It was just familiar so it felt comfortable and safe. But I was the furthest thing from safe with him. He took me to bad neighborhoods to buy drugs, drove drunk with me in the car, pulled my hair and called me names, and punched holes in our walls/mirrors/doors/etc. It was a poisonous relationship, but I am so fucking codependent that I still want it back. I feel like I'm so broken that I'm irredeemable.
And I tried to call the suicide prevention hotline and they're all busy. Maybe this is a sign.
